super6.race: Christmas Parties At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Fair form on Flat (up to 1¼m) for present yard last season. Again offered something to work with in this sphere when 21 lengths third on qualifying run at Sedgefield (17f). Now switches to a handicap and perhaps not as well treated as a couple of the other lightly-raced hurdlers.

Low-mileage 5-y-o. Built on his maiden/novice wins when fourth behind a couple of useful types on handicap debut at Hereford. Let down by his jumping both starts either side of a 6-month break. May get to the lead on return from further 8 weeks off, but he'll need to be on his game to capitalise.

super6.race: Mount Vines Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Runner-up on hurdling debut but failed to build on that in 3 subsequent starts in France for N. George & A. Zetterholm. Starts out for new connections after a breathing operation and absence of 583 days. Watching brief unless market speaks firmly in her favour.

super6.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
super6.comment: Runner-up in 6f maiden/novice events in the summer but well below par on her last 2 outings. It remains to be seen whether a switch to all-weather enables her to get her career back on track.

super6.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Foaled April 14. €75,000 breeze-up purchase. Starspangledbanner filly. Dam unraced out of useful 10.5f winner Nobilis. This newcomer would need considering if the betting speaks in her favour.

super6.race: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Handicap
super6.comment: Consistent sort who gained a second success of 2026 at Pontefract in July. A course winner who should be suited by the forecast strong pace, with his mark falling since the summer.

finals.race: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Ulysses gelding who has gone the right way in handicaps on the Flat this year, showing fairly useful form when opening his account in 9-runner handicap at Lingfield (1½m) back in September. Brings a positive profile to hurdling and he's one to note.

finals.race: Christmas Parties At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Fair form on Flat (up to 1¼m) for present yard last season. Again offered something to work with in this sphere when 21 lengths third on qualifying run at Sedgefield (17f). Now switches to a handicap and perhaps not as well treated as a couple of the other lightly-raced hurdlers.

finals.race: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Low-mileage 5-y-o. Built on his maiden/novice wins when fourth behind a couple of useful types on handicap debut at Hereford. Let down by his jumping both starts either side of a 6-month break. May get to the lead on return from further 8 weeks off, but he'll need to be on his game to capitalise.

finals.race: Outerspace Group 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Third in a pair of bumpers last spring (at this track second time up) and made a promising start over hurdles when filling the same spot at Southwell (2m) 3 weeks ago, outpaced from 2 out. This stiffer test will suit and he should improve and go well.

finals.race: Mount Vines Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Runner-up on hurdling debut but failed to build on that in 3 subsequent starts in France for N. George & A. Zetterholm. Starts out for new connections after a breathing operation and absence of 583 days. Watching brief unless market speaks firmly in her favour.

finals.race: CopyBet Supporting UK Horse Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Much improved switched to fences in 2024/25, winning 3 of his 5 starts. Seemingly hard to train having been seen only twice since, in share of third when fell heavily 2 out at Perth in September on latest of those.

finals.race: Festive Meeting Saturday 28th November 'Newcomers' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Pether's Moon filly. Dam unraced half-sister to French hurdlers/chasers (15f-2¾m winner) Saint Goustan Blue and (17f-19f winner) Viola St Goustan. Worth a look first time up.

finals.race: Come Racing At Huntingdon Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: No match for useful sort at Newcastle before going one better in a big-field maiden there in January. Again bumped into when runner-up in first-time cheekpieces at Doncaster final start last season. Opening mark potentially harsh for one who looks consistent rather than progressive.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 17. €75,000 Bayside Boy half-sister to several winners, including 2-y-o 6f winner Setarhe and 6f winner Inverleigh. Interesting newcomer for leading connections.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Twice-raced gelding. 33/1, only modest form when well-held third of 10 in novice at Southwell (7f) 51 days ago. More will be needed.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Convincing winner back at 5f in nursery at Southwell last Tuesday. Looks up to defying a 6-lb penalty under Billy Loughnane.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Runner-up in 6f maiden/novice events in the summer but well below par on her last 2 outings. It remains to be seen whether a switch to all-weather enables her to get her career back on track.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled February 13. 220,000 gns Siyouni filly. Half-sister to 3 winners, including very smart winner up to 1½m Alenquer and 2-y-o 7.4f winner in France Cte d'Escarbagnas. Dam 1m winner abroad. Makes obvious paper appeal.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 14. €75,000 breeze-up purchase. Starspangledbanner filly. Dam unraced out of useful 10.5f winner Nobilis. This newcomer would need considering if the betting speaks in her favour.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle - 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled March 17. 98,000 gns yearling, £70,000 2-y-o, Too Darn Hot gelding. Brother to 5f winner in Bahrain Bjorn Ironside and half-brother to winner up to 7f Endeared. Dam, French 1m winner, half-sister to smart winner up to 8.6f Via Serendipity. Rare 2-y-o runner (one of 2 in this) for yard.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle - 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 20. 40,000 gns yearling, Almanzor gelding. Half-brother to several winners, including smart 9.4f winner Mondo Man and 1m/8.4f winner in France Elymas. Dam unraced half-sister to smart winner up to 1m Mythical Magic. Rare 2-y-o runner for yard (also saddle Incandescence).

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: After 5 months off, produced best effort for current yard this year when fourth of 11 at Haydock (5f) in September. Hasn't been in the same form in 2 subsequent outings, though. Now switches to a visor.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Remains with only the one win at Epsom (7f) last summer when trained by Charlie Fellowes. Largely consistent this year, but without headgear he ran poorly on stable debut at Southwell last month. Cheekpieces back on, though drop back in trip not certain to suit.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: Without a win in handicaps but has made the frame on several occasions this year. Lost all chance with a rare slow start at Windsor when last seen 11 weeks ago. On a reduced mark as she starts out for Dylan Cunha.

finals.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
finals.comment: Third win of a productive first half of 2026 when overcoming a pace bias at Windsor in June. Only just failed under a penalty at Newmarket soon after and off since (subsequently sold from Ross Burdon for 46,000 gns following month and gelded). One to note with new yard going well.

finals.race: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Handicap
finals.comment: Consistent sort who gained a second success of 2026 at Pontefract in July. A course winner who should be suited by the forecast strong pace, with his mark falling since the summer.
